summary: Steep through-road kerb with no parked cars and a narrow treed verge.
reasons: Through road, no kerbside parking seen
Golf car park entrance at east end

best_section.where: West end of the south kerb of Carawa Street, beside golf course trees

drivers.seclusion: Golf course bush on this side; homes across the road 21 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow treed verge, no gravel bay; the mapped car park entrance sits at the far end.
drivers.traffic: Through road with lane markings and overhead lines; no cars on this kerb.
drivers.convention: No kerbside parking seen in either image; golf cars use the off-road lots.

sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the west end from the south and west; open to the north.
